served_mismatch: The served HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.82) describes the interventional trial at median 2.0 years. For the requested longest trial-reported follow-up, the held registry reports the overall-study primary composite through interventional and post-trial follow-up, up to 1869 days: HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.72 to 0.87).

candidate_rejections.span: During a median of 2.0 years follow-up, a primary outcome event occurred in 432 of 3304 patients (13.1%) in the empagliflozin group and in 558 of 3305 patients (16.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001)
candidate_rejections.why: Valid interventional-period result, but shorter follow-up than the overall-study primary result held in the packet.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled adults meeting CKD eligibility criteria; the selected result includes all randomized participants.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Adults with a race-adjusted CKD-EPI 16 eGFR of at least 20 but less than 45 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 of body-surface area (irrespective of level of albuminuria); or an eGFR of at least 45 but less than 90 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 with a urinary ACR of at least 200 mg/g at the screening visit were eligible

notes: Registry spans are accepted because the longest-follow-up estimate is absent from the held full text. The selected result includes non-interventional post-trial follow-up. The registry's overall-primary definition omits ESKD and states a sustained decline of more than 40%; these differ from its interventional-primary definition.
